scope_exclusion.rule: Technical on-call escalation is not evidence of user transfer to a departmental advisor.

conclusion: Partial public response pathway. A need and a public exploration response are documented; episode-level approval, implementation and feature-linked assessment remain unestablished. This is not evidence that no action occurred or that the organization failed.
